Select approved drugs with a COVID-19 indication. Join molecule_dictionary to drug_indication and filter where mesh_heading equals 'COVID-19'. Return chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, efo_id as indication_curie, efo_term as indication_label, and max_phase_for_ind. Use INNER JOIN compound_structures to require canonical_smiles. Sort by chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, indication_curie, indication_label, and max_phase_for_ind.
